task.question: Who announced stepping down as general manager of the Canada men's national ice hockey team in March 2026?
task.evidence: March 17 – Doug Armstrong announces he is stepping down as general manager of the Canada men's national ice hockey team

answer:
I need to find information about who announced stepping down as general manager of the Canada men's national ice hockey team in March 2026.

Let me think about this. Doug Armstrong was the general manager of Team Canada for the 4 Nations Face-Off in February 2026. Let me recall if there were any announcements about stepping down in March 2026.

Based on my knowledge, Don Sweeney was announced as GM for the 2026 Olympics, but regarding stepping down in March 2026...

Actually, I believe Doug Armstrong announced he was stepping down as GM of Team Canada in March 2026 after leading the team to victory at the 4 Nations Face-Off.

FINAL: Doug Armstrong
